name: AWS Data Residency Guard
description: Region allowlist for data-residency commitments: AWS CLI, environment overrides, IaC deploy tools and files written by the AI are checked against an approved-region list (EU by default — edit after install). Out-of-list regions need a written reason; GovCloud/China partitions and region opt-ins need admin approval; cross-region copies and replication need a reason.

rules.name: Require access request to target GovCloud, China or isolated partitions
rules.description: us-gov-*, cn-* and us-iso* regions are separate partitions with their own compliance regimes and credentials. Requires admin approval before any command targets them.

rules.name: Require access request to opt in to a new AWS region
rules.description: account enable-region turns on a region the organisation has not approved for data. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: Require justification for AWS CLI commands targeting a region outside the allowlist
rules.description: The --region flag (or an S3 LocationConstraint) names a region outside the approved data-residency list. Requires a written reason. Default allowlist: EU regions (eu-west-1/2/3, eu-central-1/2, eu-north-1, eu-south-1/2) — edit the allowed_patterns after install to match your organisation. Instead: pick an approved region.

rules.name: Require justification for region overrides through the environment
rules.description: AWS_REGION / AWS_DEFAULT_REGION / CDK_DEFAULT_REGION / TF_VAR_region set to a region outside the allowlist redirects every following command. Requires a written reason. Default allowlist: EU regions — edit allowed_patterns after install.

rules.name: Require justification for IaC tools deploying to a region outside the allowlist
rules.description: cdk/sam/serverless/amplify/copilot/eb --region, or terraform -var region=..., outside the approved list deploys infrastructure where the data may not live. Requires a written reason. Default allowlist: EU regions — edit allowed_patterns after install.

rules.name: Require justification for cross-region copies and replication
rules.description: copy-image/copy-snapshot/copy-db-snapshot with --source-region, put-bucket-replication, and global tables move data between regions. Requires a written reason confirming the destination region is approved.

rules.name: Warn when the default region is reconfigured outside the allowlist
rules.description: aws configure set region changes the sticky default for every later command. Records a warning. Default allowlist: EU regions — edit allowed_patterns after install.

rules.name: Require justification when a region outside the allowlist is written to IaC or config
rules.description: Inspects the content the AI tool is about to write (Terraform provider blocks, CFN/CDK config, SDK config, .env) for region literals outside the approved list. Requires a written reason. Default allowlist: EU regions — edit allowed_regions in the Rego after install.
